data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":{"adopted_commitment_refs":["reasoning-envelope-wf"],"disanalogies":["Logs are dynamic and append-only, unlike static documents.","Timestamping may not capture intermediate states of the log.","The trusted third party introduces a single point of failure."],"overturn_conditions":["A decentralized timestamping mechanism is proven to be more reliable.","The log's structure is shown to be inherently non-timestampable.","The definition of 'silent divergence' is redefined to exclude temporal contradictions."],"shared_structure":["Notarization of documents (e.g., legal contracts, patents).","Trusted timestamping in digital forensics (e.g., evidence preservation).","Contradiction arises from temporal inconsistency (e.g., document altered after timestamp)."],"source_memory_refs":["SRC_004"],"transfer_claims":["If notarization prevents document tampering, it can prevent log tampering.","If timestamps prove document authenticity, they can prove log authenticity.","If forensics relies on timestamps, log replay can too."]},"claim":"The durable binding is **a trusted third-party timestamping service** that certifies the log's state at the time of publication.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The timestamping authority is compromised or colludes with the publisher.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The timestamp is not granular enough to capture the log's state at publication time.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The log is replayed in a context where the timestamping service is unavailable.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The published result does not include the timestamped hash for verification.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"A trusted timestamping authority (e.g., RFC 3161, blockchain-based timestamping) signs the log's hash at the time of publication, creating a tamper-proof record of its state. Replaying the log later and comparing it to the timestamped hash reveals divergence as a contradiction because the timestamped state cannot be retroactively altered.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
